hero.title: Manage your properties, rents, and teams from one real estate platform.
hero.description: Yopii brings together property publishing, rental operations, contracts, maintenance, and coordination between owners, agencies, agents, and tenants.
hero.mockTitle: Find A Perfect Home or Terrain To Live With Your Family
hero.mockDescription: The shorted distance between paradise and the place you call home.

benefits.title: A platform built to sell, rent, manage, and collaborate.
benefits.description: The landing page now follows a conversion-first structure by showing what Yopii simplifies in real estate operations first.

publication.title: Publish properties with more clarity.
publication.description: Centralize listings, property details, visuals, and geographic reading in one showcase.

operations.title: Keep rents, contracts, and tenants under control.
operations.description: Owners can monitor income, occupancy, late payments, contracts, and occupant information without switching tools.

team.title: Let agencies and agents work from the same source.
team.description: Yopii connects teams, managed properties, publications, and commercial follow-up in one consistent interface.

maintenance.title: Anticipate maintenance and sensitive actions.
maintenance.description: Private spaces extend the public showcase with ticket, intervention, and business alert management.

published.title: Three published properties, presented like an editorial selection.

socialProof.title: Real data that builds trust before entering the product.
socialProof.description: Instead of abstract promises, Yopii shows the network already active on the platform: agencies, agents, tenants, and tracked volume.

finalCta.title: Make Yopii the center of your real estate operations.
finalCta.description: Whether you manage an owner portfolio, an agency, or an agent activity, Yopii gathers the essential flows to publish, follow up, and collaborate without fragmentation.

ownerCollection.title: A portfolio reading, not a dashboard.
ownerCollection.description: For signed-in owners, the landing page keeps a premium reading of their portfolio without an extra property section.
